title: JEE Main 2026 Moderate Mock A (Full Length)
description: Moderate difficulty mix: ~25% easy, ~50% moderate, ~25% difficult. NCERT Class 11-12 syllabus. 20 MCQ + 5 Numerical per subject. MCQ +4/-1, Numerical +4/0.

questions.body: Two balls are projected horizontally from the same height H with speeds v and 2v. Neglecting air drag, which statement is correct about the time they take to hit the ground?
options: Ball with speed v takes longer
